```{r}

#load data
temp_data <- read.csv("temp_data.csv")

#GLM for predicting stream temperature in December
temp_data$temp_C <- as.numeric(temp_data$temp_C)
temp_data$year <- as.numeric(temp_data$year)
# filter for dec temperatures
dec_data <- subset(temp_data, month == "Dec")

# fit a GLM model to see if there is a trend in dec temperatures over time, separated by site
dec_model <- glm(temp_C ~ year*site_no, data = dec_data)
summary(dec_model)


```
